summary: Stratus Properties Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its subsidiary's sale of the Jones Crossing Retail component to Brixmor Operating Partnership LP. The purchase price was $46.5 million in cash, with pre-tax net cash proceeds of approximately $21.7 million after selling costs and loan repayment. The retail component includes 154,092 sq ft of space and undeveloped commercial acres. Stratus retains the multi-family portion of the development. The board's recommendation was not stated; no advisor was named. The divestiture closed immediately upon filing, with no regulatory clock noted. Watch for future development on the retained multi-family parcel and potential use of proceeds.
